VEX Command-Based API

FRC-style command-based programming for VEX V5 in Java, running on the brain through Hydrozoa. Class and method names follow WPILib, so FRC code reads the same.

Where to start

  • VexRobot is the robot's lifecycle (like TimedRobot).
  • SubsystemBase, Command, Commands and Trigger are command-based programming.
  • VexController is the V5 controller.
  • VexMotor and VexMotorConfig drive motors; the rest of com.robojacks.lib.hardware covers sensors, 3-wire devices, pneumatics and the brain screen.
  • DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator and GpsPoseEstimator track where the robot is.
  • AutoBuilder and AutoSelector build and choose autonomous routines.

The guides, path planner and dashboard are on the main site. The template robot and the Clawbot example are documented here too, under their own groups.
